document.abstract: Local television stations continue to aggressively centralize their operations in a quest to operate more efficiently and to meet financial targets. Remote monitoring of on-air signals has emerged as a primary area of importance for station group managers. This paper will explore a nationwide monitoring solution that was created to allow NBC managers in New York and Los Angeles to monitor (remote and mobile) on-air signals in their eleven flagship markets across the United States.
